review_questions: Act as Reviewer 3 and independently review PR 20 candidate b0d8be7b6f082726ed54c14be19f304ac876f02b. Do not rely on proposer conclusions or prior PASS labels.

Verify the candidate is exactly the bounded two-file privacy hotfix from base a8c666a0862e3338bf3858644e79466980b11fce, preserving the red exposure commit 1711f29f7fb5f373c30c4bb8c1d99b0c0004c807 and changing no provider routing, reviewer semantics, retry policy, promotion authority, or terminal authority.

Verify public telemetry sanitization is provider-neutral and redacts account/principal identifier-like fields such as user_id/account_id/customer_id/tenant_id/org_id/organization_id without hard-coded OpenRouter-specific branches.

Verify merge_run_summaries re-sanitizes legacy attempt error_detail before public publication so already-persisted historical artifacts can remain immutable while the public representation is cleaned.

Verify the historical provider failure remains represented as a failure with timing, HTTP/error classification, retryability, model/provider/profile and authority_effect preserved after sanitization; the hotfix must not silently delete or rewrite the failure semantics.
Verify sanitizer changes do not expose secrets, do not create semantic PASS, and do not convert telemetry into review/promotion/terminal authority.

Verify the new regression test genuinely failed before mechanism repair in run 34334884029 and exact-head qualification run 34335165103 passed on repaired candidate b0d8be7b6f082726ed54c14be19f304ac876f02b.

Search adversarially for nested/quoted JSON error payloads, identifier formatting variants, accidental over-redaction of operational error classification, secret leakage, provider-specific handling, legacy-summary bypasses, or authority widening.

evidence_refs.ref: Pre-repair red run 34334884029 executed candidate 1711f29f7fb5f373c30c4bb8c1d99b0c0004c807 and failed exactly at the legacy public-summary identifier-leak test. It is historical falsification evidence, not candidate-bound CI.

Review attempt 34336362859 failed before provider inference because request HOTFIX-001 incorrectly typed historical red run 34334884029 as candidate-bound ci_run evidence, causing ci_run head_sha mismatch. No semantic disposition or provider-authenticated review resulted.

Initial live dashboard deployment a8c666a0862e3338bf3858644e79466980b11fce passed prior review/deployment but artifact inspection exposed a public provider-side user_id inside legacy OpenRouter HTTP 402 error detail; this is preserved as a false-green privacy finding.

The user/account identifier is provider-side metadata, not an API key; nevertheless it is unnecessary in the public telemetry JSON and must be redacted at publication time without deleting the historical failure record.

required_review_dimensions.description: Candidate is exactly the two-file privacy hotfix from the declared live-main base with no unrelated runtime or authority changes.
Run 34334884029 demonstrates the public identifier leak before mechanism repair and is preserved as historical failure evidence, not candidate-bound CI.
Public sanitizer redacts provider-side account/principal identifiers generically without provider-specific branches.
Historical attempt error detail is re-sanitized during public run-summary merge so old immutable artifacts can be safely republished.
Sanitization preserves the historical failure record, timing, routing, HTTP/error classification, retryability and authority effect rather than deleting or laundering it.
Public output excludes secret-like material and provider-side account/principal identifiers while retaining non-sensitive operational observability.
Privacy sanitization cannot alter semantic disposition, validation, reviewer independence, promotion authority or terminal authority.
Run 34335165103 qualifies exact candidate b0d8be7b6f082726ed54c14be19f304ac876f02b after the narrow repair.
The change introduces no OpenRouter/DeepInfra-specific sanitizer or dashboard branches and remains data-driven for future providers.
Adversarial review checks quoted/nested provider error payloads and legacy-summary paths for remaining public identifier leakage or sanitizer bypass.
Redaction does not unnecessarily remove provider/model/profile, timing, HTTP/error classification or failure-state information needed for observability.
No material remaining privacy leak, history rewrite, secret exposure, or authority-widening bypass is found within the bounded hotfix scope.
